rows.text: A clogged filter can disrupt supply and combustion, reducing efficiency and increasing fuel consumption. The effect depends on the engine and operating conditions.

Delphi, How to Deal with Blocked Fuel Filters on Common Rail Applications: restriction reduces flow and can lower pressure and power: https://www.delphiautoparts.com/apac/products-and-technologies/diesel-fuel-systems/fuel-injection/diesel-fuel-injection/how-to-deal-with-blocked-fuel-filters-on-common-rail-applications

rows.text: A clogged filter restricts supply and can cause loss of power; yellowish smoke is not a characteristic effect identifying this fault.
evidence: Delphi, How to Deal with Blocked Fuel Filters on Common Rail Applications: restriction reduces flow and can lower pressure and power: https://www.delphiautoparts.com/apac/products-and-technologies/diesel-fuel-systems/fuel-injection/diesel-fuel-injection/how-to-deal-with-blocked-fuel-filters-on-common-rail-applications

rows.text: The fuel filter concerns the engine’s fuel supply; cylinder lubrication depends on the oil circuit, which is separate.
evidence: Delphi, blocked fuel filters https://www.delphiautoparts.com/apac/products-and-technologies/diesel-fuel-systems/fuel-injection/diesel-fuel-injection/how-to-deal-with-blocked-fuel-filters-on-common-rail-applications — restriction affects fuel supply.

MAHLE, Running smoothly, https://workshop-heroes.mahle.com/en/article/running-smoothly — oil pump delivers oil from sump through lubrication channels, oil filter cleans oil, and oil film exists between piston and cylinder wall; distinct from the fuel supply described by Delphi.

rows.text: The quiz marks FALSO: a blocked filter restricts fuel to the pump and can reduce supply pressure upstream of injection. This does not establish a higher injection pressure; the effect depends on the system and operating conditions.
evidence: Delphi, blocked fuel filters https://www.delphiautoparts.com/apac/products-and-technologies/diesel-fuel-systems/fuel-injection/diesel-fuel-injection/how-to-deal-with-blocked-fuel-filters-on-common-rail-applications — restricted flow can reduce pressure; does not prove all injection-pressure responses.

Behched et al., Influence of the technical condition of the low pressure system on the fuel supply process, https://www.trans-motauto.com/sbornik/2011-1-2.pdf, pp.41–42 printed — D65 N test with simulated restriction: reduced injection-pump head pressure and changed injection timing; exact local PDF /tmp/rotonda-trans-motauto-2011-1-2.pdf SHA256 5cd1441434d31a9e2f0567dfec8be98fbee747e477e284be1cbc76a29e3c5850; no universal inference about every engine.

reviewer_evidence: Checked all 25 source records and four language explanations. 30846 maintains visible uncertainty about official FALSO while advising report to repair-responsible person and next driver where appropriate; directly checked DVSA https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-daily-heavy-goods-vehicle-hgv-walkaround-checks, which calls for defects to be reported and dangerous defects fixed.

30856: Gazzetta https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/eli/gu/2024/03/27/13/s1/pdf PDF p.40 §5.1.1 quotes penal code article43 negligence; https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/atto/vediMenuHTML?atto.codiceRedazionale=26C00131&atto.dataPubblicazioneGazzetta=2026-07-08&tipoSerie=corte_costituzionale&tipoVigenza=originario lines845–849 cites articles40–41 for causation in an administrative accounting case, not an accident decision. Wording correctly conditions liability on culpability and causal circumstances. IVASS https://www.ivass.it/normativa/nazionale/primaria/cap.pdf art.144 confirms direct action and contractual recourse scope.

Personally inspected /tmp/rotonda-trans-motauto-2011-1-2.pdf SHA256 5cd1441434d31a9e2f0567dfec8be98fbee747e477e284be1cbc76a29e3c5850 PDF pp.42–43, printed 41–42: D65 N tractor-engine experiment simulated restriction using throttle near nominal operating point, finding injection timing and fuel consumption changes; not a universal injection-pressure claim. Delphi https://www.delphiautoparts.com/apac/products-and-technologies/diesel-fuel-systems/fuel-injection/diesel-fuel-injection/how-to-deal-with-blocked-fuel-filters-on-common-rail-applications directly documents restricted upstream feed. 30867 properly states this does not establish an increase in injection pressure.

30866 replacement personally checked: MAHLE https://workshop-heroes.mahle.com/en/article/running-smoothly describes oil pump, channels, filter and piston-cylinder oil film; Delphi separately documents fuel supply. Learner text and all other rows unchanged from full review.
